data_requests.item: Existing end-use, function, demand and alternative/lifecycle basis
where: site records: Existing exact end-use/system and compressed-air service, process and safety purpose, required quality/pressure/flow and duty/load pattern, shutoff/control and current solution, source/owner/revision/availability and lifecycle/system constraints.

a walkdown: Only if an applicable question remains after reviewing existing records, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no mandatory new meter, field test, operating change or equipment replacement.
data_requests.how: S11 printed24-27 describes potentially inappropriate uses and context-dependent alternatives, not an equipment replacement instruction from a name. Establish actual compressed-air service and task requirements. Cabinet cooling is not protective panel purging. Intermittent/cyclic vacuum with suitable control and safety/practical constraints can justify a venturi; a generic load-factor example alone does not decide this installation or establish a central-pump alternative. Review existing suitable arrangements and full-system/lifecycle implications with the responsible specialist. Retain foreign, missing, zero and uncertain values; no blanket blower/fan/pump substitution or compulsory new survey follows.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual compressed-air end-use/function, safety and quality requirements, matched demand/control records and practical lifecycle/system alternatives with the responsible specialist. A source list of potentially inappropriate uses is a collection prompt, not proof of waste. Suitable existing use or nonapplicability can be acknowledged; unknown service, scope or duty remains explicit without mandatory replacement or transferred source savings.

typical_benefit.wording: S11 identifies potentially inappropriate compressed-air uses and discusses task-specific alternatives and lifecycle/system tradeoffs. The pressure-sensitive unregulated-demand share is not the fraction removable by substitution. No generic end-use saving, avoidable share or site benefit is asserted.

questions.limits: IAC/ITAC figures are browse-page averages read through a summarizing fetch and not re-verified against the downloadable database; averages are skewed by outliers. Source review: S11 printed24-27/PDF29-32 includes intermittent vacuum and explicitly distinguishes cabinet cooling from panel purging. Its historical unregulated-demand percentage concerns pressure-sensitive demand, not automatically inappropriate use, retrofit eligibility or savings. Known non-compressed-air and protective-purge roles are not cooling/sparging/vacuum subjects; unknown service is conditional.
